question: Estimate the profitability (EBITDA margin) of EV charging stations in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Public EV charging station (DC fast charger, Tata Power-tier)? Yes.
Mature station with reasonable utilization? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Revenue per kWh × utilization vs cost.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Single DC fast charger (60 kW) capacity: 60 kW × 12 hrs effective use × 365 = 2,62,800 kWh/year theoretical.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Profitability hinges entirely on utilization. At <10% utilization, loss-making.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Single DC fast charger (60 kW) capacity
benchmarkAssumptions.value: 60 kW × 12 hrs effective use × 365 = 2,62,800 kWh/year theoretical.
45,000 kWh × ₹20/kWh (charging operator selling price) = ~₹9 lakh/year per charger.

calculationFlow: Single DC fast charger (60 kW) capacity: 60 kW × 12 hrs effective use × 365 = 2,62,800 kWh/year theoretical.
Revenue: 45,000 kWh × ₹20/kWh (charging operator selling price) = ~₹9 lakh/year per charger.
But: depreciation on ₹15-20 lakh charger over 7 years = ~₹2.5 lakh/year → PAT close to break-even.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Profitability hinges entirely on utilization. At <10% utilization, loss-making.
